'''Susumu Chiba''' (Japanese: '''千葉進歩''' ''Chiba Susumu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Chiba was born on September 13, 1970 in {{wp|Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. Chiba's most notable role on {{aniseries|PTS}} was that of [[Lance]]. He has also voiced a few {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. Chiba was once affiliated with Marine Entertainment, and is now with Office Osawa.
